observed_behavior: Metric cards render as passive articles even though CSS, keyboard delegation, and browser contracts require inspectable controls; no inspectMetric action exists.
expected_behavior: Every metric card is an accessible keyboard/click control that opens a human/machine-readable metric record without granting authority.
operational_impact: Dashboard summary values consume space but cannot expose their meaning or machine-readable evidence, and the operational UI walk blocks.

discovery_evidence.claim: Playwright timed out waiting for the first inspectMetric control and visual selectors could not resolve inspect-cue.
The shared card renderer emits no action, role, keyboard focus, or inspect cue.

next_action: Restore accessible metric controls and a typed information-modal action, then rerun the focused browser walk.

display.detail: Values display but the inspect affordance is absent.

input_validation.detail: Read-only metric inspection has no user payload.

result_acknowledgement.detail: No human or machine-readable result appears.

failure_handling.detail: Missing action fails as inert UI.

reload_reopen.detail: Inspection is derived from the current snapshot.

recovery_rollback.detail: Read-only modal has no rollback boundary.
